title: Microscopy - Magnification Calculations
description: Learn how to use a light microscope and calculate magnification. Key concepts: image size, real size, and the magnification triangle.
subject: Biology

blocks.content:
### Using the Microscope

A light microscope uses lenses to magnify small objects. You can see cells and their structures clearly.

### The Magnification Formula

Magnification = image size divided by real size. Remember this formula for your exam.

### The IAM Triangle

Use the triangle to remember: Image = Magnification × Actual size. Rearrange to find any unknown.

### Cell Structures

Under the microscope you can see the cell membrane, nucleus, and cytoplasm in plant and animal cells.

### Summary

Remember: the microscope gives us magnification. Use the triangle for calculations. Cell biology relies on microscopy.
